name: Abyssinian Longclaw
rangeDescription: High grassland of ethiopia
description: A large and relatively colorful member of the pipit family. Note the black necklace, orange throat, and partially yellow eye-stripe.

name: White-capped Munia
rangeDescription: Lowlands of java and bali
description: Beautiful small songbird with a shining white head, black “bib”, deep chestnut body, and silverish-blue bill. Similar to White-headed Munia, but much darker overall, with a contrasting dark throat and chest.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: New Guinea Eagle
rangeDescription: Forest of new guinea
description: A huge raptor of lowland and montane forest. Note long legs, pale belly, dark back and hint of a crest at the back of the head.

name: Samoan Whistler
rangeDescription: Samoa (savai'i and upolu)
description: A small bird with strikingly bright golden underparts and slate-gray upperparts. The small golden eyebrow reaches the eye but doesn’t extend behind it.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Greater Yellow-headed Vulture
rangeDescription: The guianas and southern venezuela to northern bolivia and northern brazil
description: Widespread and common vulture in lowland rainforest. Head may not appear yellow unless seen at close range.

name: Black-faced Ibis
rangeDescription: Coastal peru and coastal far northern chile, and central chile and central argentina southward to tierra del fuego
description: Large, boldly patterned, and often noisy ibis. Common and conspicuous in cooler and wetter regions of southern Chile and Argentina; uncommon and more local in northern areas.

name: Andaman Serpent-Eagle
rangeDescription: Forest of andaman islands
description: A relatively small, uniformly dark brown eagle with a contrasting bright-yellow bare patch between the eye and the bill. The underparts are speckled with small white spots.

name: Pavonine Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Tropical south america east of the andes to northeastern argentina
description: Bizarre looking cuckoo; small-headed with a very long, graduated tail. The head, neck and breast are rufous, but note the prominent rufous eyebrow.

name: Red-backed Sierra Finch
rangeDescription: Andes of southwestern bolivia to northern chile and northwestern argentina
description: Handsome “finch” that is actually a tanager; found very locally on bogs and rocky slopes of the high Andes. Usually in pairs (sexes look similar) or small groups, feeding quietly on the ground and not associating with other seed-eating birds.

name: Barnacle Goose
rangeDescription: High arctic eastern greenland, svalbard (north of norway), novaya zemlya and nearby kolguyev and vaygach islands (northwestern russia); winters to coastal northern british isles, southern scandinavia, and northwestern europe
description: Handsome and distinctive. A rather compact and fairly small goose with big white face patch, silvery upperparts, and black neck and breast sharply demarcated from white belly.

name: Sooty Tit
rangeDescription: Mountains of central china (sichuan, southern gansu, southern shaanxi, and southwestern hubei)
description: Active little bird with a chocolate-brown chest and a bright white collar. Forages in the lower and middle levels of foothill and montane forest in flocks, often with other species.

name: Taliabu Masked-Owl
rangeDescription: Taliabu (sula islands)
description: A distinctive barn-owl species confined to Taliabu in the Moluccas. Shows a characteristic heart-shaped pale face bordered with a broad black line.

name: Javan Oriole
rangeDescription: Java
description: Rare oriole endemic to the mossy montane forests of Java. Male is glossy black with a crimson breast and wing spot, while the female is dull black overall with a dirty-pink breast and belly; note pale bill on both.

name: Pleske's Grasshopper Warbler
rangeDescription: Eastern siberia to korea, kyushu, and izu islands; winters in southern china
description: The brownest of the Asian grasshopper-warblers, with the least contrasting brow stripe and darkest underparts. Breeds in dense grassy areas on small islands off the coasts of Japan, far eastern Russia, and the Korean Peninsula, where it may be seen perched on the top of a bush singing.

name: Ferruginous Duck
rangeDescription: Discontinuous palearctic; winters to india, southeastern asia, and eastern china
description: Rich rusty brown overall with contrasting white triangular patch under tail; male has pale eye. Also note peaked crown and rather long gray bill.

name: Black-breasted Hillstar
rangeDescription: Andes of peru (junín, huancavelica, ancash, lima, and ayacucho)
description: Large hummingbird found only at very high elevations in the Andes of central Peru. Male is dusky green with a sparkling green throat, a blue breast and belly, and gray sides.

name: Chinese Sparrowhawk
rangeDescription: China and korea; winters to southeastern asia, philippines, and indonesia
description: Attractive accipiter of wooded habitats. Adult gray above with orange-suffused white underparts; also note bright yellow cere (skin around the nostrils).

name: Fernwren
rangeDescription: Montane wet tropical zone of northeastern queensland
description: Small scrubwren-like bird found in wet rainforests at higher elevations in the Atherton Tablelands of far northern Queensland. Adult entirely brown except for white throat, black bib, and faint pale supercilium.

name: Red-collared Lorikeet
rangeDescription: Northern australia (kimberley region to gulf of carpenteria)
description: Large lorikeet. Very colorful, with a bright orange breast and neck, blue/black belly and head, and red bill.

name: White-winged Lark
rangeDescription: Arid steppes of central eurasia
description: Handsome lark with flashing white wing patches. Note streaky gray-brown back, white underparts, and warm rufous shoulder; male also has distinct red cap and ear coverts.
